import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Define source file paths
    source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_37/test_0.csv"
    source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_37/test_1.csv"
    source2_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_37/test_2.csv"
    source3_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_37/test_3.csv"
    source4_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_37/test_4.csv"

    # Load source tables
    df_intervencion = pd.read_csv(source0_path)
    df_deteccion = pd.read_csv(source1_path)
    df_main = pd.read_csv(source2_path)
    df_actividad = pd.read_csv(source3_path)
    df_causa = pd.read_csv(source4_path)

    # Inspect columns to avoid duplicate unnamed columns (drop if exist)
    for df in [df_intervencion, df_deteccion, df_main, df_actividad, df_causa]:
        unnamed_cols = [col for col in df.columns if col.startswith("Unnamed")]
        if unnamed_cols:
            df.drop(columns=unnamed_cols, inplace=True)

    # Merge df_main with df_intervencion on 'Intervencion' to get IdInterv
    # But df_main already has 'Intervencion' as string and df_intervencion has IdInterv and Intervencion
    # We want to get IdInterv from df_intervencion by matching Intervencion string
    df_main = df_main.merge(df_intervencion, on='Intervencion', how='left')

    # Merge df_main with df_deteccion on 'Deteccion' to get IdDeteccion
    df_main = df_main.merge(df_deteccion, on='Deteccion', how='left')

    # Merge df_main with df_actividad on 'Actividad' to get IdActividad
    df_main = df_main.merge(df_actividad, on='Actividad', how='left')

    # Merge df_main with df_causa on 'Causa' to get IdCausa
    df_main = df_main.merge(df_causa, on='Causa', how='left')

    # Rename columns to match target schema exactly
    # Target schema:
    # ['Fecha': string, 'IdAhogado': integer, 'IdPersona': integer, 'Localidad': string, 'Provincia': string, 'CCAA': string,
    #  'Hora': string, 'Latitud_inc': float, 'Longitud_inc': float, 'Sexo': string, 'Edad': float, 'Nacionalidad': string,
    #  'Origen': string, 'Extraccion': string, 'Causa': string, 'TipoAhogamiento': string, 'Factor': string,
    #  'Intervencion': string, 'Pronostico': string, 'Localizacion': string, 'Riesgo': string, 'Reanimacion': string,
    #  'Vigilancia': string, 'Actividad': string, 'Deteccion': string, 'ID': integer, 'Estacion': string, 'Estado': string,
    #  'Latitud_est': float, 'Longitud_est': float, 'T_med': float, 'T_max': float, 'T_min': float, 'Presion': float,
    #  'Dir. vi.': float, 'V_Viento': integer, 'Nubosidad': float, 'ProfNievecm': float, 'InsolacHoras': float,
    #  'Distancia': float, 'IdActividad': integer, 'IdCausa': integer, 'IdDeteccion': integer, 'IdInterv': integer]

    # The source df_main has 'Precipitaciones' column which is not in target schema, drop it
    if 'Precipitaciones' in df_main.columns:
        df_main.drop(columns=['Precipitaciones'], inplace=True)

    # Ensure columns order and types according to target schema
    target_columns = [
        'Fecha', 'IdAhogado', 'IdPersona', 'Localidad', 'Provincia', 'CCAA', 'Hora',
        'Latitud_inc', 'Longitud_inc', 'Sexo', 'Edad', 'Nacionalidad', 'Origen', 'Extraccion',
        'Causa', 'TipoAhogamiento', 'Factor', 'Intervencion', 'Pronostico', 'Localizacion',
        'Riesgo', 'Reanimacion', 'Vigilancia', 'Actividad', 'Deteccion', 'ID', 'Estacion',
        'Estado', 'Latitud_est', 'Longitud_est', 'T_med', 'T_max', 'T_min', 'Presion',
        'Dir. vi.', 'V_Viento', 'Nubosidad', 'ProfNievecm', 'InsolacHoras', 'Distancia',
        'IdActividad', 'IdCausa', 'IdDeteccion', 'IdInterv'
    ]

    # Some columns might be missing in df_main after merges if no matches found, fill them with NaN or appropriate default
    for col in target_columns:
        if col not in df_main.columns:
            df_main[col] = pd.NA

    # Reorder columns
    df_main = df_main[target_columns]

    # Convert data types according to target schema
    # Define dtype mapping
    dtype_map = {
        'Fecha': str,
        'IdAhogado': 'Int64',
        'IdPersona': 'Int64',
        'Localidad': str,
        'Provincia': str,
        'CCAA': str,
        'Hora': str,
        'Latitud_inc': float,
        'Longitud_inc': float,
        'Sexo': str,
        'Edad': float,
        'Nacionalidad': str,
        'Origen': str,
        'Extraccion': str,
        'Causa': str,
        'TipoAhogamiento': str,
        'Factor': str,
        'Intervencion': str,
        'Pronostico': str,
        'Localizacion': str,
        'Riesgo': str,
        'Reanimacion': str,
        'Vigilancia': str,
        'Actividad': str,
        'Deteccion': str,
        'ID': 'Int64',
        'Estacion': str,
        'Estado': str,
        'Latitud_est': float,
        'Longitud_est': float,
        'T_med': float,
        'T_max': float,
        'T_min': float,
        'Presion': float,
        'Dir. vi.': float,
        'V_Viento': 'Int64',
        'Nubosidad': float,
        'ProfNievecm': float,
        'InsolacHoras': float,
        'Distancia': float,
        'IdActividad': 'Int64',
        'IdCausa': 'Int64',
        'IdDeteccion': 'Int64',
        'IdInterv': 'Int64'
    }

    for col, dtype in dtype_map.items():
        if col in df_main.columns:
            try:
                if dtype == 'Int64':
                    # pandas nullable integer type
                    df_main[col] = pd.to_numeric(df_main[col], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')
                elif dtype == float:
                    df_main[col] = pd.to_numeric(df_main[col], errors='coerce')
                else:
                    df_main[col] = df_main[col].astype(dtype)
            except Exception as e:
                # If conversion fails, keep original and print warning
                print(f"Warning: Could not convert column {col} to {dtype}: {e}")

    # Write the transformed dataframe to the target CSV file
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_37/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    df_main.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
